description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 18399/APP/2026/586, dated 05-06-2026 (Additional access into the site at the front, with widening of the existing access road with fencing; erection of a canopy and welfare unit to the front; lowered concrete yard area with 3 x dock doors and wheel guides; 1 x level loading door; installation of fencing and bollards, and an additional waste area) to amend the height of the approved canopy, removal of ramp and installation of stairs, and the installation of a new arm barrier.
